page.title: Storefront API
page.description: Connect an e-commerce website to this shop's catalogue, stock and orders.

manager.emptyDescription: Make a key and give it to the person who builds your website.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke "{name}"?
revokeDialog.description: The key stops working immediately and cannot be put back. Every website that uses it loses access until you make a new key.

newKeyDialog.title: New key
newKeyDialog.description: A key lets one website read this shop's data. Give each website its own key.
newKeyDialog.toastCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.

minted.title: Your new key
minted.description: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it somewhere safe. If you lose it, revoke this key and make a new one.

guide.title: Connect your website
guide.description: Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <key> from your server, never from the browser.
guide.secretWarningTitle: The key is a server secret.
guide.secretWarningBody: This API sends no CORS headers on purpose, so a call from browser JavaScript will fail. A key put into front-end code is public: anyone can read it and use it.
guide.variantFootnote: For a product with variants, add the variantId of the chosen variant to each order item.

readCatalogue.title: Read the catalogue
readCatalogue.description: Walk the full catalogue with nextCursor, or pass updatedSince to poll for what changed.

readStock.title: Read stock levels
readStock.description: The cheap, frequent call. Pass ids for the items in a cart, or updatedSince to poll for movement.

placeOrder.title: Place an order
placeOrder.description: Stock goes down at once. Send the same idempotencyKey again after a timeout: the order is not counted twice.

actions.apiNotEnabled: The storefront API is not enabled for this store.
actions.maxKeysReached: This store already has 10 active keys. Revoke one first.
actions.keyNotFound: Key not found or already revoked.
